english:
Each <solar Ignition /> also creates a Fulmination.

Fulminations deal <pve 171 /> <pvp [30] /> <solar Solar /> damage in a 12 meter radius, count as an <solar Ignition />, and have no damage falloff. Fulmination damage can be scaled by <solar Ignition /> buffs such as <exotic Dawn Chorus />.

Equipping <solar Ember of Char /> makes Fulminations apply an additional 40 stacks of <solar Scorch /> (60 with <solar Ember of Ashes />).

This allows chain Ignitions with <solar Ember of Ashes />.

source.text:
Ignitions deal an additional damage instance.

Fulmination deal 171 [30] Solar Damage in a 12 meter radius. 
Fulminations count as an Ignition and don't [do] have damage falloff.
Fulmination Damage can be scaled by Ignition buffs (Dawn Chorus)

While Ember of Char is equipped:
Fulminations inflict an additional x40+20 Scorch.
Allows chain-ignitions when paired with Ember of Ashes.
